name: @opal42/extension
description: Opal42 Gradient Score: a DevTools panel that lists the CSS gradients on the inspected page with their smoothness score. Chrome, Edge and Firefox from one codebase. No permissions, no network, no telemetry.
author: LightSeek3r (https://github.com/LightSeek3r)

scripts.build: wxt build && wxt build -b firefox && vite-node scripts/check-manifest.ts
scripts.zip: npm run build && wxt zip && wxt zip -b firefox
